literature: Gunaydin et al., magical supergravity from degree-3 Euclidean Jordan algebras, and subsequent octonionic magical supergravity reviews.
physics_contrast: E6(-26) as U-duality of octonionic magical 5D supergravity is NOT automatically the same gauged complex/compact E6 GUT used in the 27-Higgs F-term sector.

topological_vector_obstruction.condition: Need 24 extra independent vector/charge degrees to upgrade this particular 3-variable STU cubic to the 27-variable E6(-26) Jordan norm. A matching polynomial abc alone is not such an upgrade.
topological_vector_obstruction.nonclaim: Other metric KK vectors, dual p-form fields, massive states or nongeometric sectors might contribute, but no complete 27-vector E6(-26) supergravity reduction is derived.
